title: THE MINES RESORT & COUNTRY CLUB

blocks.html: Malaysia, a land blessed with abundant natural resources, became the world’s largest producer of tin in the early 20th century. Fetching lucrative prices, the precious mineral was mined extensively and excavations gave birth to the nation’s progressive development in its infancy. Uniting both miracles of the man and nature, a unique transformation of the world’s largest open-cast tin mines was set in motion in 1909. The cessation of mining in 1982 transfigured a land once rich in precious minerals into a wonder that is s manifestation of aesthetic beauty and the splendor of nature, The Mines Resort & Golf Club. For more information, visit https://www.minesgolf.com.my/

title: Annual Sponsorship Partnership 2024
excerpt: MATRIX CONCEPTS GROUP ANNOUNCES ANNUAL SPONSORSHIP PARTNERSHIP WITH SENIOR GOLFER’S SOCIETY OF MALAYSIA ——————————————————————————————————————– KUALA LUMPUR, 22 February 2024: The Senior Golfer’s…

blocks.html: MATRIX CONCEPTS GROUP ANNOUNCES ANNUAL SPONSORSHIP PARTNERSHIP
WITH SENIOR GOLFER’S SOCIETY OF MALAYSIA

KUALA LUMPUR, 22 February 2024: The Senior Golfer’s Society of Malaysia (SGSM) together with Matrix Concepts Group is delighted to announce its strategic partnership as the official sponsor collaboration partners for the year 2024.
This partnership signifies a shared commitment to promotes the sport of golf among seniors and fostering a sense of solidarity among senior golf enthusiasts in Malaysia.

Through this sponsorship collaboration, Matrix Concepts Group is reaffirming its dedication to support the grassroots initiatives and promoting healthy lifestyles among seniors through the sport of golf.

According to the Group Chairman of Matrix Concepts, Dato’ Haji Mohamad Haslah Bin Mohamad Amin, the company’s sponsorship support will include prominent branding and recognition across Senior Golfer’s Society of Malaysia (SGSM) events, promotional materials, and digital platforms.
The partnership will also offer unique networking opportunities, hospitality benefits, and brand exposure to Matrix Concepts Group within the Malaysian golfing community.
“We are proud to collaborate with (SGSM) in promoting the sport of golf and encouraging active lifestyles among seniors as we believe in the power of sports to unite communities and enrich lives.

Through this partnership also, we aimed to inspire and empower senior golfers to pursue their passion for the game while promoting health, wellness and solidarity”, he said during the handing over of the cheque presentation today.

Also present together during the handing over of the cheque amounted to RM250,000.00 were the Founder and Group Executive Deputy Chairman of Matrix Concepts, Dato Seri Lee Tian Hock and President of Senior Golfer’s Society of Malaysia (SGSM) Dato Shamsudin bin Ismail.
According to the President of SGSM, Dato Shamsudin bin Ismail, these efforts will provide vital support to (SGSM) programs, tournaments, and events throughout the year.
The sponsorship will enable (SGSM) to expand its reach, enhance its offerings, and provide enriching experiences for senior golfers across the country.

“We are thrilled and grateful to be in these partnerships with Matrix Concepts Group for the annual sponsorship initiative as this corporation exemplifies our shared values of excellence and mutual beneficial to our 3,000 members in Malaysia.

The RM250,000.00 sponsorship donation from Matrix Concepts Group will support various activities and initiatives organized by SGSM, including hosting of events tournaments and branding awareness programs.
For more information about Matrix Concepts Group and its commitment to community development, please visit our website at www.mchb.com.my.
To know more about Senior Golfer’s Society of Malaysia (SGSM) and its initiatives, please visit the website at www.sgsm.com.my.

title: Kelab Rekreasi Tentera Udara
excerpt: Kelab Rekreasi Tentera Udara (KRTU), also known as Royal Malaysian Air Force (RMAF) Recreation Club is located within the perimeter of a RMAF Subang Air Base. KRTU was the country’s […]

blocks.html: Kelab Rekreasi Tentera Udara (KRTU), also known as Royal Malaysian Air Force (RMAF) Recreation Club is located within the perimeter of a RMAF Subang Air Base. KRTU was the country’s first all-Malaysian golf project. Malaysians were responsible for not only the planning, design and construction, but also continue to maintain and manage the golf club. KRTU was the brainchild of formal RMAF Chief of Air force, Allahyarham Lt Jen (R) Tan Sri Mohamad bin Ngah Said. The Army Engineer Corps help clear the land in the mid-80s. The project took 123 acres of swampland and oil palm plantation and turned it into a 6,224-metre par-72 course that offers a wide variety of holes. The slopes and valleys of the original terrain have been largely retained, which means numerous elevated tees and a fair number of precarious fairway lies. Palm oil trees, in abundant numbers, also tighten these fairways and stand guard over the layout’s greens. For more information visit, www.krtu.net

title: Templer Park Country Club
excerpt: It’s easy to be mesmerized by the might Bukit Takun limestone hills that towers over Templer Park Country Club as it takes on different moods depending on the weather. Early […]

blocks.html: It’s easy to be mesmerized by the might Bukit Takun limestone hills that towers over Templer Park Country Club as it takes on different moods depending on the weather. Early starters will be welcomed by hills shrouded by thin veils of mist while on a good clear day, especially towards sunset, the “living” monument shimmers in its own special glow. Built on a former mining wasteland, the course features a combination of flat and undulating terrain, measuring 6,725 yards from the blue markers with the ability to stretch to a stern 7,143 yards from the championship tees. For more information, visit www.tpcc.com.my
